fact: On 10 April the INTIC trained 18 judges of the Administrative Tribunal on the SCDM and demonstrated its Advanced Electronic Document Signer; the State root certification authority is established and can accredit second-level certification entities.
title: INTIC capacita Juízes Conselheiros no uso de Assinaturas Electrónicas
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação
